native_context: Kafka principal, topic/group and transactional authorization
taxonomy_note: Planning compatibility lens only. Classify the final observed root cause independently; unsupported mappings stay unassigned.

controls.boundary: Kafka principal, topic/group and transactional authorization — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Read principal mapping, authentication, effective broker/controller authorizer configuration, ACL patterns and topic/group/transactional-resource use. Record cluster/version.
controls.controlled_verification: On an owned fixture cluster or supplied authorization trace, compare an intended produce/consume operation with a prohibited topic or consumer-group operation under the same principal. Resolve literal/prefixed pattern and operation semantics for that exact resource.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A topic ACL alone does not establish consumer-group authority. A permissive-looking ACL fragment may not be effective under the actual authorizer and other decisions.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Bind principal, resource pattern and operations to the tenant contract and preserve necessary client behavior. Retest allowed produce/consume, denied cross-tenant tuple and group lifecycle.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
